_help: AutoResearch preset default config keeps internal plans, receipts, packets, and run artifacts in hidden .research-agent/, the single runtime artifact root; the bare legacy research-agent/ tree is a migration input, never a runtime alternative, and the runtime fails closed on it with a pointer to scripts/migrate-workspace.mjs. Completed user-facing deliverables are published under outputs/. MODEL ASSIGNMENT IS CENTRALIZED IN roleProfiles BELOW: every role has exactly one entry there and its model is chosen in that one place. An optional roleProfiles.<role>.modelFallbacks array is an ordered handoff chain: when a model fails with a provider/route error the role runner steps to the next entry, and a per-workspace breaker (<artifactRoot>/model-breaker.json, cooldown roleExecution.modelFallbackCooldownMs) makes later role runs skip a rate-limited model until the cooldown expires; a success on a model clears its entry. There is no separate roleModels bucket and no per-role tool list here — per-role tools are fixed by the built-in role manifest (the integration editor already carries read_image there). judgePanel is an optional per-judge override and only takes effect when research_judge.model is omitted. _recognizedModels is the pick list of valid 'provider/model' strings (refresh with autoresearch_list_models; unrecognized strings are flagged by autoresearch_dependency_check). The integration editor must use a multimodal model for visual inspection — if the default model in your deployment is text-only, point research_integration_editor at a multimodal model in roleProfiles. Each role may set reasoningEffort to a provider-supported effort identifier; unset roles use the provider default. This file is the single source of truth for deployment model routing: edit roleProfiles below directly instead of maintaining a separate config.local.json overlay.
